name: 14203 · Buffalo, NY
findings: ZIP 14203 (Buffalo) has 157 nonprofit organizations. 89 of them (57%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 77 organizations.
Research and think tank organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 14203 (Buffalo) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 14203 (Buffalo) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 19.2 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 77 organizations here; 22% of all organizations here have no identified type.
